questions.question: What was the central feature of Copernicus's model of the universe?
options: It placed the Sun rather than Earth at the center.
It placed Earth at the center of the universe.
It placed the Moon at the center of the universe.
It placed Mars at the center of the universe.
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Copernicus formulated a model of the universe that placed 'the Sun rather than Earth at its center.'
Incorrect. The article explicitly says Copernicus's model placed the Sun, not Earth, at the center.
Incorrect. The article does not mention the Moon as the center of Copernicus's model.
Incorrect. The article does not mention Mars as the center of Copernicus's model.
